event_description: State of emergency declared in 37 Ohio counties for severe weather and flooding highway/bridge damage starting February 2019
Governor DeWine declares state of emergency in 11 counties and activates Ohio National Guard following severe storms/tornadoes
Governor DeWine declares state of emergency for eight Northeast Ohio counties (Ashtabula Cuyahoga Geauga Lake Lorain Portage Summit Trumbull) following tornadoes and strong storms
Governor DeWine declares state of emergency in four Southern Ohio counties (Lawrence Jackson Pike Scioto) following severe weather with high winds and flooding
Governor DeWine issues proclamation proactively declaring a state of emergency ahead of Winter Storm Fern
